the food security and supply chain management should be based on a comprehensive approach.

governments should take the following measures: 1) Ensure food security through timely and effective interventions; 2) Ensure availability of food supply through appropriate policies; 3) Ensure access to food through effective communication, coordination and collaboration; 4) Ensure affordability of food by providing subsidies and incentives; and 5) Ensure safety of food through effective monitoring, inspection and enforcement.
